title: Rabbi Yose bar Elyakim
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned once in [Berakhot 9b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.9b.16), testifying in the name of the holy congregation in Jerusalem: “Whoever joins the blessing of redemption directly to the Amidah will suffer no harm all day.” Hyman suggests that he may be the brother of Rabbi Shimon ben Elyakim, a leading disciple of Rabbi Yochanan.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1941&lang=en) give Rabbi Yose ben Elyakim reporting in the name of the holy congregation in Jerusalem. Hyman has bar Elyakim and tentatively names Rabbi Shimon ben Elyakim as his brother.
